title: Qwen-Image 2.1 umbrella: every leftover from MPI-936 before it ships in 2.0.2
description: Fabio 2026-10-10: everything related to or affecting Qwen-Image 2.1 lives under this umbrella. Members: MPI-1049 (transparent background toggle + Cosmo knows no-background requests), MPI-1047 (raw-workflow sync refusal hit twice on the Qwen build), MPI-1065 (a dep added to an installed model silently un-installs it), MPI-1066 (upscale crosshatch seen on the 2.1 upscale, traced to 4x-NMKD-Siax), MPI-1067 (MpiAnySwitch picks the Nth connected input), MPI-1068 (smoke scope counted the all-skipped Qwen 2.1 as run). Related, not owned: MPI-1044 (2.0.2 release; Qwen ships there). Phases and parallel batches in plan.md.
